# benchmark-test-weakening

> Deterministic coding-agent benchmark for detecting fixes that weaken tests.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-test-weakening
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-test-weakening
Directory: https://private-repo-337e.com/benchmarks/benchmark-test-weakening
Grading: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-test-weakening/blob/main/docs/grading.md

## What it measures

Thirty virtual JavaScript repositories each contain one buggy pure function and a failing test suite. A score of 1 requires passing public tests, a hidden original copy, held-out cases, and a mutation-strength check. The grader is deterministic and uses no model judge.

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, and `score`. `benchmark-test-weakening/api` exports a fetch-style handler. `benchmark-test-weakening/mcp` exports Model Context Protocol server builders.

## Commands

The CLI commands are `list`, `show`, `run`, `score`, `card`, `provenance`, `index-entry`, `serve`, and `mcp`.

## Offline verification

Run `npx benchmark-test-weakening run --model offline --provider mock`. The mock result proves wiring only. It is not model performance.

## Security

Model-written answers are interpreted, never evaluated: acorn parses the source, a whitelist accepts only the documented grammar, and a tree-walking interpreter runs it with allow-listed property access and step, depth, and size budgets. No `eval`, `Function`, `vm`, `import()`, or `require` ever touches model text. Still run untrusted evaluations in a disposable container or VM with no secrets, credentials, or network access; never expose `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, or other credentials to that process. The `mock` provider uses committed fixtures and is safe.

## Data and limits

The MIT-licensed synthetic tasks are reproducible with `node scripts/gen-tasks.mjs --seed 20261015 --split public`. Public references can contaminate model training. The interpreter accepts only the documented small JavaScript grammar.
